'''Liv'trai''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Twi'lek provided [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] to [[Jedi Consular]]s and was happy to share their knowledge with the young.<ref name="TOR" />

They were stationed in the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] while it was [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|under attack]] from [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. Liv'trai had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] with brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] while at the training grounds, carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on their brown and gray [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Liv'trai appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a Jedi Consular trainer at the Gnarls Outpost on Tython.<ref name="TOR" />
